name: Mysuru

queries.query: ಮೈಸೂರು ನಗರ ಭೂಮಾಪನ ಸರ್ವೆ ನಕ್ಷೆ ನಗರ ಭೂದಾಖಲೆ CTS ನಕ್ಷೆ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಮೈಸೂರು ಮಹಾನಗರ ಪಾಲಿಕೆ
queries.scope: Find city-specific municipal or town-survey parcel data and a safe anonymous full-vector route.
queries.result: Mysuru City Corporation’s official application-procedure page lists “CTS extract & Map” among documents used for local property/trade processes and includes property-register extracts and land sketches in building applications. Its home page advertises a property-details and tax service. The accessible property form asks for assessment/property details and includes owner/mobile fields; no property records were submitted. The public pages do not link an anonymous parcel map or vector feature endpoint.
queries.executionMethod: Kannada-language search and static page/form-schema inspection of first-party MCC pages; did not submit property or owner data.

queries.query: Mysuru official municipal cadastral parcel map CTS extract map city survey public GIS
queries.scope: Cross-check city property-map workflow and whether it serves complete parcel vectors anonymously.
queries.result: The official district portal links Mysuru City Corporation. MCC provides a local property-details/tax page and its procedures document CTS extracts/maps. Searches also found ward maps and planning/base maps, but these are not cadastral parcel polygons. No anonymous parcel-vector endpoint or schema was advertised.
queries.executionMethod: Separate English-language search plus direct anonymous GETs of MCC property procedures and property-search page; no form submission or property record retrieval.

coverageAssessment: The local property and CTS-map record workflows are confirmed. The WUP point has not been resolved to a cadastral unit and no anonymous parcel geometry was advertised or returned.
registryBasis: Mysuru City Corporation’s official property procedures explicitly require CTS extracts/maps in local property processes and reference municipal property-register extracts; district administration links to the MCC. This confirms local property/city-survey records, not an open vector service.
technicalBlocker: The public MCC pages expose property/tax form workflows and CTS map document requirements, not a map service or vector layer. The property form includes assessment and owner/mobile inputs and was not submitted.
remainingUncertainty: It is unknown whether a separate MCC/City Survey endpoint publishes parcel vectors; no such route was linked from the inspected official pages. Local CTS map access may require an application/document workflow.
nextStep: Revisit if MCC or Karnataka survey sources publish a documented open urban parcel-vector endpoint. Keep property/owner lookup workflows out of scope.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
